items.claim: No compression data exist for wrapped K13D2U-class tubes or for any pitch or M-series multidirectional laminate. The laminate value is the data-sheet UD strength over 051's 0 deg ply ratio.
items.needed_to_ground: Axial compression of a population of full-length wrapped tubes with fittings; a flat-laminate coupon first.

items.claim: The Weibull modulus is m = 1.2/CV from coupon CVs of 5.1% (n=6, pitch K63712) and 5.2% (an NCAMP IM fibre), plus CMH-17's 6% floor. No pitch tube scatter exists.
items.needed_to_ground: The same tube population, fitted for m.

items.claim: Size scaling moves a 0.32 cm3 compression gauge to one tube's volume. 052 used 1 cm3 for SiC, which differs by about 6% at m 20. Whether fibre-composite compression follows volume scaling is not established.
items.needed_to_ground: Tube and coupon strengths of the same laminate.

items.claim: Walls thicken uniformly at fixed radius, with peak stress as 1/wall. 051's FE is not re-run at the thickened walls, and the hail stress power fit (wall exponent -1.13 to -1.30) is carried from 051's 0.98-3.6 mm walls to as much as 17 mm.
items.needed_to_ground: Re-run 051's frame FE and hail model at the sized walls.

items.claim: The 0 deg ply's first failure is taken as the laminate's compressive failure, using 051's lamination ratios for virtual laminates.
items.needed_to_ground: Laminate compression of the actual layup.

items.claim: 052's SiC sleeve, bond and node bill is kept. Sourced strut fitting shares (17-70% of the strut) would add 0.2-2.3 times the tube mass. The peak member load, 775 kN, exceeds the largest sourced composite strut test (121.7 klb, 541 kN). Bonded fittings failed at about 70% of design ultimate.
items.needed_to_ground: A bonded end-fitting test at 775 kN on a 247 mm, 1.45 mm-wall tube.

items.claim: 052's PBO film and barrier lines are carried unchanged. Attaching the film to carbon tubes, and the thermal mismatch between near-zero-CTE pitch tubes and the film, are not addressed.
Epoxy-matrix tubes inside the evacuated cavity hold absorbed water. 054's capture, sized for a SiC frame, does not carry it, and no uptake was sourced here.
items.needed_to_ground: Moisture uptake and outgassing of the laminate in vacuum.

items.claim: 054's cavity rows cover R 10-15. R 20 and 30 extrapolate the barrier as R^2 and the capture as a + bR^2 (R 12 reproduced within 0.5%).

Ice thresholds are for flat quasi-isotropic PAN panels, 1.59-6 mm thick (the T800 table is an interim 2010 snapshot). There are none for tubes, pitch fibres, walls under 1.5 mm or preloaded members. Tube data are hard-impactor only. The 52% CAI retention is a single row.
items.needed_to_ground: Ice-gun strikes on preloaded full-size tubes of the chosen layup.

items.claim: T700S strength is 051's Toray value (1.45 GPa), not re-sourced. T700S frames are stiffness-limited, so the answer does not depend on it.
Hybrid layups (PAN 0 deg plies over pitch), other ply angles, tube radii and frame geometries are not explored. The frame is 051's and 052's fixed family.
items.needed_to_ground: A layup and geometry search on the same account.
